content: Hairballs come from drawing all nodes/edges and from visualization-first layouts. Fix: hierarchical LOD (package→file→symbol), layout constrained by precomputed communities not Leiden-raw 1:2 clusters, semantic zoom + minimap, cap payload (~200 nodes/fetch in comparable IDE graphs). Leiden on software graphs produces many small communities — do not treat community IDs as visual regions without a hierarchy/size floor.
